race.comment: QUOTHQUAN (2) has  made a bright start to this prep, and he looks ready to strike again after a determined runner-up finish over 1600m at Rockhampton on a rain-affected track 2 weeks ago. He is still on the up with his fitness, and is looking for this trip now. On top. KEITEL (1) was impressive when beating the top pick by nearly 2 lengths at Rockhampton last start and he only has to cope with a middle distance for the first time, to be hard to hold out again. ZOOLOGY (3) continues to race consistently and another placing would come as no surprise after his latest Rockhampton effort for third behind the top 2 picks. Stick with him. FALCON OF MALTA (12) hit the line strongly in tougher company at Doomben 2 weeks ago, and he should appreciate carrying 4kg less in this assignment, while ODEGAARD (10) finished just half a length from the winner here last time out when second, and he is capable of featuring prominently once again.
